data.one_liner: Picture in Picture mode management for Flutter on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps on Android to enter and manage Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode. It provides a helper PiPSwitcher widget to toggle UI elements based on PiP status and methods to check availability and enable PiP.
use_when: You are building a video player or call app that needs Picture-in-Picture support on Android
You need to conditionally render different widgets depending on whether the app is in PiP mode
avoid_when: Your target platform includes iOS or web, as PiP is Android-only here
You do not need native Picture-in-Picture functionality
strengths: Provides a ready-to-use PiPSwitcher widget for easy UI toggling
Supports customizable aspect ratios and source rect hints for smooth transitions
data.setup_notes: Add android:supportsPictureInPicture="true" to the activity tag in AndroidManifest.xml.
